pragma solidity ^0.8.16;

interface IMessageProvider {
    event InboxMessageDelivered(uint256 indexed messageNum, bytes data);

    event InboxMessageDeliveredFromOrigin(uint256 indexed messageNum);
}

devdoc.details: The billing contract allows for Graph Tokens to be added by a user. The tokens are immediately sent to the Billing contract on L2 (Arbitrum) through the GRT token bridge.

TokensSentToL2(address,address,uint256).details: Tokens sent to the Billing contract on L2
